body.name: Exact one-collision persistence family
body.construction: For every \(\vartheta\in(-1/100,1/100)\), let \(\psi^{\diamond}_{\vartheta}\) be obtained from \(\psi^{\diamond}\) by replacing only \(c_{130}=3/10\) by \(c_{130}(\vartheta)=3/10+\vartheta\), and let \(\psi^{\diamond,\mathrm{sw}}_{\vartheta}\) be obtained from \(\psi^{\diamond,\mathrm{sw}}\) by the identical replacement of its treated coordinate. All other primitive coordinates are unchanged. Define \(P^{\diamond}_{\vartheta}=F(\psi^{\diamond}_{\vartheta})\). Thus \(\psi^{\diamond}_{0}=\psi^{\diamond}\), \(\psi^{\diamond,\mathrm{sw}}_{0}=\psi^{\diamond,\mathrm{sw}}\), and \(P^{\diamond}_{0}=P^{\diamond}\).
